page.overview:
Who is Blaine?

Blaine is a character from Pokémon Red and Green Version. Also known by his title The Hotheaded Quiz Master, Blaine serves as the seventh Gym Leader at Cinnabar Island's Gym. He specializes in using -type Pokémon and gives the Volcano Badge to the trainers able to defeat him.

Blaine is an old man of medium height. He has a bald head, black round glasses and a white moustache, slightly similar to whiskers and slightly resembling Dr. Robotnik's.

Blaine wears a white lab coat over a white collared shirt with a purple tie. He also has a black belt with a golden buckle, dark green trousers, and black shoes..

Blaine wears a white lab coat over a dark green collared shirt with a red tie with 3 orange pokeball logos. He has a black belt with a silver buckle, blue trousers, and black shoes.
